[h1] Esse jogo é o motivo de eu ter conta na Steam [/h1]

Conheci Cobalt logo quando a Mojang implementou aquele launcher com feed de notícias no Minecraft onde indicava o Cobalt como um outro jogo deles.

Consegui acesso as primeiras versões em 2012, muito antes do lançamento em 2016 aqui na Steam. Joguei muito os modos base do game que ainda não contava com campanha, Plug Slam, posteriormente Capture The Plug, e Deathmatch.

Quando tive a oportunidade de obtê-lo imaginei que eu pudesse comprar e executar via launcher do Minecraft, foi então que encontrei ele aqui na Steam, criei conta e [b]se tornou meu primeiro jogo e um dos jogos meus jogos favoritos.[/b]

O multiplayer dele é bem divertido, as mecânicas de [b]Slow Motion e Deflect[/b] de projéteis e o funcionamento de granadas de flash e de explosão são o que mais considero satisfatório neste game.

Muitos [b]mapas na oficina, mapas de desafios e mapas adicionais[/b] para os modos existentes e claro, editor de mapas garantem que eu continue voltando pra esse jogo.

Este juego es una joya olvidada de un pasado que quisiera haber jugado en su prime.
Hace 8 años tenia una xbox360 en la que jugaba muchas demos y esta es una de las pocas que me gusto por su gameplay y estetica unica y queria algun dia poder comprarlo y jugar en linea.
No me arrepiento de haber comprado este juego en su totalidad, aunque no llevo mucho jugando el juego, la historia es muy entretenida haciendote preguntarte que paso con los humanos y porque los robots son hostiles y no reconocen a cobalt.
El modo arcade es bueno por si solo, dejandote jugar con hasta 8 bots sin contar al jugador y teniendo mucha personalizacion para las partidas dejando personalizar cosas como la dificultad de los bots, elegir con que items aparece tu personaje, elegir de una larga lista de temas predeterminados y dejandote crear tus propios presets de configuraciones, y hasta dejando escoger entre modos de juego como supervivencia, duelo en equipos, y otro pareciendo una clase de futbol pero con el uso de armas y de mas.
Aunque el online esta sumamente olvidado, el resto de el juego es completamente jugable sin ayuda de amigos, pero si puedes jugar con otro control en el mismo dispositivo hasta dejandote crear perfiles.
La conclusion seria que si buscas un juego plataformero shooter arcade con mucha rejugabilidad, deberias comprarlo sin dudas.

My first experience with the game came from downloading its Xbox 360 demo years ago, followed up consequently by buying the full game, and later the Xbox One version. Playing the PC edition and experiencing all the new features renewed my love for this game.
   Cobalt is a mechanically solid game; its rapid, technical movement and intuitive shooting creates smooth combat scenarios. Flying across the map, dodging and deflecting gunfire in slow motion, and closing in for a swift kill feels as great as ever. The Melee weapons strike with unique characteristics, and each gun serves its function well. Obtaining equipment and using it to its maximum potential allows for dynamic strategies and memorable gameplay moments. New back-ported features from Cobalt's sequel, Cobalt WASD, fit like a glove and refresh the already satisfying sandbox. 
   Despite what I may say, no game can ever be perfect, and Cobalt is no exception. Several achievements bugged out and are simply unattainable; rendering the game impossible to fully complete as of now. Cobalt's campaign also leaves much to be desired; its pacing whiplashes wildly and the campaign feels unfinished when playing (due to insane development hell). Some enemy balancing decisions aren't the best either, especially the armored deathshrooms in both Campaign and survival. The overall content pool in the game is also not all that abundant; with the arcade mode selection stretched thin to fit several radically different game modes.
   Its not the game for everybody; but if you're looking for a small, action-packed experience with a passionate community; Cobalt may just be the game for you.

By far the best combat game I've played, and the most underrated game I've played. This game is better than almost anything I've experienced and I have no clue why it's so underrated.

Seriously, it throws almost all the flaws of other combat games out of the window, making strategy a big part of the game. 

Forget having to react quickly, cobalt lets you slow down time and kick a grenade back into your enemy's face if you know what to do, or smack an unsuspecting predator mech with a chrono rod a billion times to slow it down, then fire a storm of bullets at it... or even fire a bullet at a bouncy pad to redirect it back up to a plug to hit it exactly the right way so that it will bounce into the goal...

(of course, stuff like time dilation and available weapons can be messed around with and changed based on your preferences)

Oh, and there's tons of maps. Not all of them are masterpieces but some of them are total classics. Not to mention the giant list of community-made maps and the pretty easy-to-learn level editor.


Seriously, every single time I fire up this game and play a survival match, a combat challenge, or whatever it is, crazy things happen that would never be experienced in any other combat game.

The soundtrack is also a banger.


The only cons I could think of were:

- Barely anyone in the online servers (playing with friends via remote play or locally is more fun anyway)

- Local profiles are a little bit buggy and sometimes copy names

TL;DR Best combat game I've played so far, extremely underrated. Get a friend or two and do remote play, you won't regret it. Just don't try to find online matches

Cobalt is very Enjoyable. 

Gameplay - 5 out of 10 - The gameplay is fast paced and skill isn't a big factor due to the lack of aiming in cobalt. Gameplay might get a little repetitive but is still extremely fun especially when playing multiplayer.

Effects - 9 out of 10 - Cobalt has the best post processing out of any 2D game I've played. The effects are fluent with the gameplay and really adds a dimension to the game.

Stability/Bugs - 10 out of 10 - while I really cannot say because I only have about 16 hours on this game (12 console, 4 steam cobalt) I have ran into no bugs or stability issues. 

Game design - 7 out of 10 - The game has pretty good game design. The plot is decent but quite cliche. This game has very nice UI and it fits the UI nicely into the game without being confusing. For example, the health is the how damaged the character appears.

Level Design - 7 / 10 - The level design is very nice in the way it make it feel like open world. There are different Section, fit seamlessly together. You can carry things through levels and while, in general, there is only one path to the end of a mission, The feeling of a labyrinth because of the other rooms and hallways you can go through bringing you back to the same spot. The minor downside is that there are a few areas that are hard to get to.

all in all - 7 out of 10 - Great emmersive game that looks good, with a little dry gameplay.
